Wholesale used-car auction marketplace (Buffalo), IPO March 2021 (NASDAQ: ACVA). Market cap $1.78B as of 2026-09-25 (stockanalysis.com).

Security analytics (Boston). 'In September 2008, Rapid7 received its first institutional funding, a $7 million investment from Bain Capital Ventures' (Wikipedia; Ben Holzman on the board since August 2008, its S-1): the first institutional round of a bootstrapped company, read as its Series A. The Form D band read a 2010 filing as Seed. IPO July 2015 (NASDAQ: RPD); market cap $783M as of 2026-09-25 (stockanalysis.com).

Mobile messaging for commerce (New York). BCV led the Series A (its own post, 2018-03-14), which the filings also give. Mark: the $470M Series E of March 2021 (Wikipedia), which PYMNTS (June 2021) reports made Attentive 'a $5 billion unicorn'; no priced round since (an IPO was postponed in 2023), so $5B, stale, aligned with Atomico. Sequoia's $2.7B (2025) is an uncited secondary estimate, which Rule A does not let band a row.
